annotations.title: Is this site readable by AI assistants?

description: Use when the user asks why AI assistants do not cite their site, whether their site is "AI friendly", or whether they block ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity: "is our robots.txt blocking AI?", "do we need an llms.txt?". Reads the site’s robots.txt (verdicts for 11 AI crawler tokens, grouped into search, live fetch and training), its llms.txt and its home page without running scripts (readability, H1, schema.org types, meta description, noindex), and returns a pass/fail checklist with a plain fix for each failure. Refuses before you are charged if the site cannot be read. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: one moment; re-run after a fix. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For whether AI answers cite the site for a buyer question, use run_ai_visibility.
